# star patterns


## question 1 hollow diamond

the first program prints a hollow diamond using nested loops.
the number of spaces before the stars and the space between the stars are calculated using n
conditional statements are used to print stars only at the required positions
## question 2 butterfly pattern
this program prints a butterfly pattern using nested loops
the pattern is divided into an increasing part and a decreasing part
for every row the program calculates the number of stars and the spaces in the middle
the program works for any positive value of n
